meta.title: How It Works — Set Up Your Salah, Zikr & Qur'an Routine
meta.description: Set up Munib Tracker in a minute: choose your location, log each Salah, follow your adhkar, plan Qaza, read and practise the Qur'an, and review your week.

title: Set up your worship routine in a minute
intro: Munib Tracker fits around the five daily Salah. Here's how to get started, and what a typical day looks like once you do.

download.title: Download and open the app
download.text: Install from the App Store or Google Play, or open the [web app]({webAppUrl}). There's no account to create: everything works straight away and stays on your device.

location.title: Set your location
location.text: Allow location or search for your city, then choose your calculation method and Asr madhab. Your Salah times appear on the home screen with the Hijri date and a countdown. [More on Salah times](/features/prayer-times-qibla).

log.title: Log each Salah
log.text: After you pray, tap the Salah and mark it completed, delayed, missed or Qaza. Your streak and progress ring update instantly. [About the Salah tracker](/features/salah-tracker).

adhkar.title: Add your adhkar
adhkar.text: Open the session for the time of day (morning, evening, after Salah or before sleep) and tap to count. Each zikr shows its source. [About the Zikr tracker](/features/zikr-tracker).

qaza.title: Make a plan for missed Salah
qaza.text: If you have Qaza to make up, estimate it once and pick a daily pace. The app shows what's left and when you'll finish. [About the Qaza tracker](/features/qaza-salah-tracker).

quran.title: Read and practise the Qur'an
quran.text: Set a khatm plan for a daily target, and use [Qur'an practice](/features/quran-practice) to recite with an on-device listener and revise what you're memorizing.

reminders.title: Turn on only the reminders you want
reminders.text: Salah, Adhan, adhkar, Qaza, Friday and more. Every reminder is off until you switch it on, so the app never nags you.

review.title: Look back once a week
review.text: Check your statistics and weekly report, see what's growing, and choose one small thing to improve next week. [About worship progress](/features/worship-progress).

stepCaptions.location: Today's Salah times and the next Salah countdown.
stepCaptions.log: The tracker with today's progress and streak.
stepCaptions.adhkar: Adhkar grouped by time of day.
stepCaptions.qaza: Qaza remaining, made up, and the finish date.
stepCaptions.quran: Continue reading or start a khatm plan.

day.title: What a day with Munib Tracker looks like
day.intro: An example routine. Start with whatever part of it feels easy, and add the rest over time.

fajr.text: Mark Fajr, run the after-Salah adhkar, then the morning adhkar and today's khatm pages.

dhuhr.text: A reminder at work; mark it from the widget once you've prayed.

asr.text: Pray, then make up one Qaza Salah alongside it if you have a plan.

maghrib.text: Evening adhkar, and ten minutes of Qur'an practice on what you're memorizing.

isha.text: Mark Isha and Witr, then the before-sleep adhkar when you go to bed.

data.title: Where your information lives

device.title: On your device by default
device.text: Without signing in, your Salah, Qaza, zikr and notes are stored only on your phone, tablet or browser.

sync.title: Synced only if you choose
sync.text: Sign in with Google, Apple or Facebook to sync between devices. You can delete your account and data at any time.

backups.title: Backups you control
backups.text: Export a backup file from Settings and import it on another device, without an account.

data.more: Read the full <privacy>privacy policy</privacy> or see <why>why we built it this way</why>.
data.devicesCaption: The same tracker on the TV, an Android tablet, iPhone and iPad. Sign in to keep them in step.

cta.title: Ready when you are
cta.text: Download Munib Tracker and set your location. Your first Salah log is one tap away.
